title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: How much to talk in games
hook: How much do you talk during games?
intro: You coach every play from the sideline.
Players keep looking over at you.
statement: Games are where kids practice making their own decisions.
q1: Do you stay mostly quiet and let them play —
q2: or guide them through each moment?
q3: Who is making decisions out there, you or them?
t1: There is no single right way. But players grow
t2: when they get to make the choices.
ctaLines: Quiet unless needed. Positive only. Constant guidance.
ctaPrompt: Share your sideline habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
How much do you talk during games?
You coach every play from the sideline. Players keep looking over at you.
Games are where kids practice making their own decisions.
Stay quiet or guide them. Every team is different.
Talk or stay quiet? Share your habit in the comments.
